annotations.text:
lookfx — desktop shell

Left: source / depth / output + ordered effect stack (enable, solo, reorder).
Center: viewport = generalised PointPicker (light, anchor, solved track path, search ring) over the live preview; transport with in/out marks; play steps cached frames only.
Right: the selected effect's panel — the ported Flarecore editor or the ported CMYK Magic panel.
Bottom: render job bar (SSE progress, cancel, open folder).

Palette, radii, control heights lifted from Flarecore's .fcore stylesheet (#131317 / #1a1a20 / #e8a33d, 3–4 px radii, 36 px buttons, 44 px chips).
